title: Wonderful plants!
text: Wonderful plants!. Ok, first thing..when you open the box, do it on the bottom so you can push these out of the box. Otherwise you will do what I did. I opened from the top and reached in to pull one out, and ended up with a bunch of leaves I pulled out.lol They are in bubble wrap and packed in very well. I was able to stick them back in. No breakage or odd shapeing. When you do get them unwrapped, you can fluff out the stems and leaves to make it fluffy again. These are so cute and look so real. I especially love the pots they are in because they look like natural grey stone. These will look great no matter where you put them.
